  let rec part l =
    match l with

let undefine =
  let rec undefine_list x l =
    match l with
      (a,b as ab)::t ->
          let c = Stdlib.compare x a in
          if c = 0 then t
          else if c < 0 then l else
          let t' = undefine_list x t in
          if t' == t then l else ab::t'
    | [] -> [] in
  fun x ->
    let k = Hashtbl.hash x in
    let rec und t =
      match t with
        Leaf(h,l) when h = k ->
          let l' = undefine_list x l in
          if l' == l then t
          else if l' = [] then Empty
          else Leaf(h,l')
      | Branch(p,b,l,r) when k land (b - 1) = p ->
          if k land b = 0 then
            let l' = und l in
            if l' == l then t
            else (match l' with Empty -> r | _ -> Branch(p,b,l',r))
          else
            let r' = und r in
            if r' == r then t

operations.after:
let undefine x t =
  let rec undefine_list_changed x l =
    match l with
      (a,b as ab)::t ->
          let c = Stdlib.compare x a in
          if c = 0 then Some t
          else if c < 0 then None else
          (match undefine_list_changed x t with
             None -> None
           | Some t' -> Some(ab::t'))
    | [] -> None in
    let k = Hashtbl.hash x in
    let rec und_changed t =
      match t with
        Leaf(h,l) when h = k ->
          (match undefine_list_changed x l with
             None -> None
           | Some l' ->
               Some(if l' = [] then Empty else Leaf(h,l')))
      | Branch(p,b,l,r) when k land (b - 1) = p ->
          if k land b = 0 then
            (match und_changed l with
               None -> None
             | Some l' ->
                 Some(match l' with Empty -> r
                                    | _ -> Branch(p,b,l',r)))
          else
            (match und_changed r with
               None -> None
             | Some r' ->
                 Some(match r' with Empty -> l
                                    | _ -> Branch(p,b,l,r')))
      | _ -> None in
  match und_changed t with None -> t | Some t' -> t';;

let (|->) x y t =
  let newbranch p1 t1 p2 t2 =
    let zp = p1 lxor p2 in
    let b = zp land (-zp) in
    let p = p1 land (b - 1) in
    if p1 land b = 0 then Branch(p,b,t1,t2)
    else Branch(p,b,t2,t1) in
  let rec define_list (x,y as xy) l =
    match l with
      (a,b as ab)::t ->
          let c = Stdlib.compare x a in
          if c = 0 then xy::t
          else if c < 0 then xy::l
          else ab::(define_list xy t)
    | [] -> [xy] in
  let k = Hashtbl.hash x in
  let rec upd t =
    match t with
      Empty -> Leaf (k,[x,y])
    | Leaf(h,l) ->
         if h = k then Leaf(h,define_list (x,y) l)
         else newbranch h t k (Leaf(k,[x,y]))
    | Branch(p,b,l,r) ->
        if k land (b - 1) <> p then newbranch p t k (Leaf(k,[x,y]))
        else if k land b = 0 then Branch(p,b,upd l,r)
        else Branch(p,b,l,upd r) in
  upd t;;

let combine op z t1 t2 =
  let newbranch p1 t1 p2 t2 =
    let zp = p1 lxor p2 in
    let b = zp land (-zp) in
    let p = p1 land (b - 1) in
    if p1 land b = 0 then Branch(p,b,t1,t2)
    else Branch(p,b,t2,t1) in
  let rec combine_list op z l1 l2 =
    match (l1,l2) with
      [],_ -> l2
    | _,[] -> l1
    | ((x1,y1 as xy1)::t1,(x2,y2 as xy2)::t2) ->
          let c = Stdlib.compare x1 x2 in
          if c < 0 then xy1::(combine_list op z t1 l2)
          else if c > 0 then xy2::(combine_list op z l1 t2) else
          let y = op y1 y2 and l = combine_list op z t1 t2 in
          if z(y) then l else (x1,y)::l in
  let rec combine op z t1 t2 =
    match (t1,t2) with
      Empty,_ -> t2
    | _,Empty -> t1
    | Leaf(h1,l1),Leaf(h2,l2) ->
          if h1 = h2 then
            let l = combine_list op z l1 l2 in
            if l = [] then Empty else Leaf(h1,l)
          else newbranch h1 t1 h2 t2
    | (Leaf(k,lis) as lf),(Branch(p,b,l,r) as br) ->
          if k land (b - 1) = p then
            if k land b = 0 then
              (match combine op z lf l with
                 Empty -> r | l' -> Branch(p,b,l',r))
            else
              (match combine op z lf r with
                 Empty -> l | r' -> Branch(p,b,l,r'))
          else
            newbranch k lf p br
    | (Branch(p,b,l,r) as br),(Leaf(k,lis) as lf) ->
          if k land (b - 1) = p then
            if k land b = 0 then
              (match combine op z l lf with
                Empty -> r | l' -> Branch(p,b,l',r))
            else
              (match combine op z r lf with
                 Empty -> l | r' -> Branch(p,b,l,r'))
          else
            newbranch p br k lf
    | Branch(p1,b1,l1,r1),Branch(p2,b2,l2,r2) ->
          if b1 < b2 then
            if p2 land (b1 - 1) <> p1 then newbranch p1 t1 p2 t2
            else if p2 land b1 = 0 then
              (match combine op z l1 t2 with
                 Empty -> r1 | l -> Branch(p1,b1,l,r1))
            else
              (match combine op z r1 t2 with
                 Empty -> l1 | r -> Branch(p1,b1,l1,r))
          else if b2 < b1 then
            if p1 land (b2 - 1) <> p2 then newbranch p1 t1 p2 t2
            else if p1 land b2 = 0 then
              (match combine op z t1 l2 with
                 Empty -> r2 | l -> Branch(p2,b2,l,r2))
            else
              (match combine op z t1 r2 with
                 Empty -> l2 | r -> Branch(p2,b2,l2,r))
          else if p1 = p2 then
           (match (combine op z l1 l2,combine op z r1 r2) with
              (Empty,r) -> r | (l,Empty) -> l | (l,r) -> Branch(p1,b1,l,r))
          else
            newbranch p1 t1 p2 t2 in
  combine op z t1 t2;;

entries.semantic_rule: The rev, length, mapf, foldl, foldr, applyd, and already identity-normalized undefine rewrites eta-expand the same total list or Patricia-tree functions, preserving element order, tree shape, callback order, fold order, lookup/default behavior, result values, and polymorphism while avoiding CakeML's value restriction; rev and length are also the forms independently used by the corresponding Candle/HOL Light lib.ml. The paired Patricia-tree update/combine binding is split into two parameterized public functions containing the same private algorithms: update retains newbranch and define_list, while combine retains newbranch, combine_list, and its original recursion. This preserves argument order, hashing, comparison, branching, callback order, zero-elision, and returned tree values without relying on polymorphic generalization of an expansive pair. Candle's already-loaded Num.gcd_num implements the same integer gcd operation as the unavailable OCaml Big_int conversion sequence, so the redundant inner module binding is omitted exactly as in Candle lib.ml. The filter, partition, uniq, and Patricia-tree undefine rewrites carry an explicit changed/all-unchanged result instead of observing physical identity, preserving structural results, callback order, exception order, and the original unchanged object whenever the source did. The exact selected graph has no qmap caller outside its recursive definition, so the normalized binding fails closed if a missed dynamic or future call reaches it.
entries.scope_limit: The eta expansions and pair split are confined to the pure rev, length, mapf, foldl, foldr, applyd, undefine, (|->), and combine bindings and do not change any theorem or proof. The split reallocates private pure helper closures at each public update/combine call, so compiled behavior and practical performance remain direct-run gates. The gcd reuse is confined to integer-valued num inputs, matching both source and Candle implementations. qmap is a selected-graph non-use refinement, not general qmap compatibility; final full-run fingerprints, performance measurements, and a compiled normalized-source run remain release gates.
